hero.filename: Astoria and Saddle Mountain from Chinook Point.jpg
hero.caption: The city of Astoria, Oregon, United States (middle distance), and Saddle Mountain as seen across the mouth of the Columbia River from Chinook Point, Washington. Photo taken from adjacent to historic coastal artillery emplacements at Fort Columbia State Park.
